_readme: Measured from the running Python app by tools/capture_reference.py; see its docstring for the full description.
Coordinates: window client pixels, origin top-left. Rect = {x, y, w, h}. Colours #rrggbb.
states.<state>.elements: Tk widget rect ('rect'), clipped rect when ancestors clip it ('visible'), pixel-measured painted box ('ink'), requested size ('req').
states.<state>.text: per label: string, font key (see 'fonts'), Tk text_top_y and baseline_y (TkComputeAnchor centring), ink box from pixels, expected vs measured colour.
states.<state>.log: Text widget options, yview, every visible display line with rect, baseline, level, ink.
states.<state>.text_regions: what tools/ui_diff.py counts as text.
shapes: corner radii fitted from pixel coverage, border widths, checkbox/radio/dot/scrollbar geometry, raw pixel grids (rows of 'rrggbb' hex, space-separated).
colors: expected (source/theme) vs measured; match=false is a finding, see 'notes'.

layout: Tk pack results (idle; per state in states.<state>.pack): requested vs actual sizes of the root's and the content frame's slaves, including what happens to the 713 px of requested height in 700 px.
notes: findings that the numbers alone do not explain.

environment.capture_method: PrintWindow(frame hwnd, PW_CLIENTONLY | PW_RENDERFULLCONTENT) into a 32-bit DIB; DWM composition, so correct when the window is covered

layout.note: Tk pack results for the idle state; states.<state>.pack has them per state (the buttons row widens when the Launch label is long)

notes.height_overflow: The root's pack slaves request 713 px in a 700 px client: header 70 + pady 10, footer 28 + pady 5, content 485 + pady 10, buttons row 60 + pady 45. Tk pack hands out height in packing order (header, footer, content, buttons), each slave getting its full request while the cavity lasts, so header, footer and content are untouched and the buttons row, packed last, absorbs the whole 13 px: it gets 700 - 80 - 33 - 495 = 92 px, minus its pady 35 + 10 = 47 px of height (requested 60). Pack does not clip it; it resizes it, and the two CTkButtons inside are resized to 47 px and redrawn at that height (painted 46 px, see even_floor_painting). The row starts at y 610 (content bottom 575 + 35), buttons occupy y 610-656, the 10 px pady follows, and the footer sits at 667-694 with 5 px below it. content's expand=True gets no extra height. The Rust layout must produce buttons 47 px tall (46 painted), not 60.
notes.header_title_squeeze: The header frame is fixed at 70 px (pack_propagate False) and the title label has pady 20, so the label gets 30 px though its text needs 32 (Segoe UI 24 bold linespace). Tk centres the text block with C integer division: top = 20 + int((30 - 32) / 2) = 19, baseline 45.
notes.label_text_placement: Every text sits in a plain tkinter.Label whose height is the font linespace times the line count, centred inside its CTk widget. When the widget is shorter than the text (title, wrapped game names, status dots) the block is centred by TkComputeAnchor with C integer division (truncates toward 0). text_top_y and baseline_y in states.*.text follow that rule and were checked against the pixels: for every single-line text without descenders the bottom ink row + 1 equals baseline_y (baseline_check).
notes.columns: content is 1170 px wide (window 1200 - padx 15 * 2). Requested widths: games 200 + padx 10, apps 200 + padx 10, log 400 (CTkTextbox width). The 350 px surplus goes to the three expanding columns, each taking int(remaining / columns left): 116, 117, 117. Result: games x 15 w 316, apps x 341 w 317, log x 668 w 517 (log is packed side=right but last, so it fills the remainder).
notes.even_floor_painting: CTk's DrawEngine on Windows (font_shapes) floors a canvas's width and height to even numbers before drawing. Odd-sized widgets leave their last column / row unpainted (parent colour shows): app cards 317x55 paint 316x54, game cards 316x55 paint 316x54, the log box 517x445 paints 516x444, the action buttons 200x47 paint 200x46, Browse buttons squeezed to 80x35 paint 80x34. Card pitch is 65 px (55 + 10 pady), so the visible gap between cards is 11 px. elements.*.painted holds the measured box; shapes.*.rule_matches confirms the rule for each shape kind. One visible exception: when a canvas is odd-sized, the anti-aliasing of the right-hand corner glyphs spills faintly into the unpainted last column; at high contrast that shows (the 205 px Launch button in mixed / log-full paints x 387-590 and has 8 faint pixels at x 591, so its measured ink box is 205 wide).
notes.corners: Corners are anti-aliased circle glyphs (CustomTkinter_shapes_font) of radius round(corner_radius) centred (r, r) in from each painted corner. Measured by area fit, the effective radius is about r - 0.5 and differs per corner: tl/br about 5.8 and tr/bl about 5.2 for r 6; 10.6 / 11.35 for r 12. shapes.*.corner_grids hold the raw corner pixels as ground truth. Card borders are 1 px (shapes.app_card.border). The header's corners are invisible (#252526 on #242424).
notes.status_dot: The dot is the U+25CF glyph in Segoe UI 40 px, in a label that requests 24x54 but is squeezed to 24x35 by the 55 px card (pady 5 / 15). In every card and state its ink is the 18x17 box at (card.x + card.w - 36, card.y + 19), where card is the widget rect; as a disk its radius is 8.6 and its centre (card.x + card.w - 26.6..26.9, card.y + 27.5); the 0.3 px spread is glyph anti-aliasing varying with x position (elements.*.dot.disk per card, shapes.status_dot for the pixels). 'stopping' has no STATUS_COLORS entry and paints #666666.
notes.checkbox_radio: Checkbox: 24x24 canvas at (card.x + 10, card.y + 15), radius 6 (effective ~5.5), unchecked border 3 px #949a9f with the card colour inside, checked fill #1f6aa5 with a #e5e5e5 checkmark glyph (ink box 14x12 at +5,+6). Radio: 22x22 canvas at (card.x + 10, card.y + 16), circle of radius 11; unchecked ring 3 px #949a9f, checked ring 6 px #1f6aa5, inside the card colour. Disabled checkboxes and radios paint exactly like enabled ones: CTk only recolours their (empty) text label. shapes.checkbox_* and shapes.radio_* include the full pixel grids.
notes.buttons: Disabled CTkButtons keep their fill; only the text turns #999999 (gray60). A CTkButton's width is a minimum: with 'Launch with iRacing (5)' (181 px of text) the Launch button grows to 181 + 2 * 12 (corner radius) = 205 px, the row becomes 445 px and is re-centred (x 377). Text in a button is centred in the full widget height (47 px for the action buttons).
notes.browse_squeeze: Inside a card, pack serves the left-packed checkbox and name block first; the right-packed Browse button (packed when the status becomes not_found) gets what is left, at most 80 px. With 'MarvinsAIRA Refactored' (164 px) only 57 px remain (all-missing: x 586 w 57, painted 56x34) and the text is centred in that. Browse height is 35 (36 requested, card 55 minus pady 10 * 2).
notes.game_name_wrap: GameCard wraps names longer than 18 characters at the last space before 18: 'Assetto Corsa Competizione' becomes two lines. The label (38 px of text) is squeezed to 35 by the card, so its block starts 1 px above the label (baselines 279 and 296 for a card at y 255).
notes.log: Consolas 14 px: ascent 13, descent 4, line pitch 17, advance 8 px. The Text widget sits 6 px inside the log box on the left and top (corner radius 6) and 6 px from the right / bottom edge (or 3 px + 8 px scrollbar + 3 px on the right when the scrollbar shows); it has borderwidth 1 and padx/pady 1, so the first line's top is log.text.y + 2 and its left edge log.text.x + 2. wrap=char: 62 characters per display line without the scrollbar (501 px inner width), 61 with it (493 px). Every message ends with a newline, so an empty display line follows the last message; see('end') scrolls until that empty line is fully visible, which leaves the top line cut (log-full shows 6 px of it). The divider is 50 U+2500 characters = 400 px, painted as a 1 px line 8 px below the line top. states.*.log.lines lists every visible display line with its rect, baseline and ink.
notes.scrollbar: The log's CTkScrollbar appears only when the content overflows (CTk polls every 200 ms). It is 8 px wide at x = log.box.x + 506 (1174), from y 129 to 562; its track is the log colour (invisible), the thumb #696969 is a pill (radius ~4 / effective ~2.6) whose length and offset follow yview (shapes.scrollbar_thumb).
notes.fonts: Font sizes in the source are pixels (CTk passes them to Tk negated). Segoe UI resolves to Segoe UI, Consolas to Consolas. Metrics in 'fonts' are Tk's for the exact descriptor; Tk line height = ascent + descent. text_regions in ui_diff absorb glyph-edge differences.
notes.colors: Every surface, border, text and state colour sampled from the screenshots equals the value in the source or in CTk's blue.json (dark variant). See 'colors' for the table.
notes.window_corners: Windows 11 rounds the window's outer corners. PrintWindow returns the full client area, so the reference images show client content in the bottom corners; a screen grab would show 35 desktop pixels there instead (environment.capture_check).
